name: Vendor Compliance Playbook
description: Standard for vendor/supplier compliance and procurement contracts.

required: encryption at rest and in transit
red_flags: no audit right for security incidents
costs fully borne by auditing party

assignment.acceptable: neither party may assign without written consent
red_flags: free assignment to any third party

standard_clauses.data_protection: Each party shall comply with applicable data protection legislation including the UK GDPR. The Supplier shall notify the Customer of any personal data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware.
standard_clauses.audit_rights: The Customer shall have the right to audit the Supplier's compliance with this Agreement upon 30 days' written notice, no more than once per calendar year.
